body.name: source-class affine recession ray
body.construction:
Define
\[
\phi(x)=\min\{-x,1/2\}\mathbf 1\{x\in[-1,0]\},
\qquad x\in[-1,1].
\]
For every \(c\in\mathbb R\), retain the observed vector with law \(P^{\circ}\), and define the affine static schedules
\[
Y_1^{Q_c^{\circ}}(d)=-\frac{c\phi(X)(d-X)}{Z},
\qquad
Y_2^{Q_c^{\circ}}(d)=-\frac{c\phi(X)(d-D_2)}{Z},
\qquad d\in[-2,2],
\]
with both quotient terms set equal to zero on \(\{Z=0\}\). This construction defines \(Q_c^{\circ}\).
